atomization_scope: All formal graded recommendations and Practice Points were atomized, plus five guideline-level definition/scope/method assertions. Secondary reports of individual trial results were not converted into primary-study quantitative atoms.
omissions_and_reasons: The 937-item main bibliography and 102-item data-supplement bibliography were extracted to Markdown but were not atomized; bibliography entries are provenance infrastructure, not evidence assertions.

Individual trial/meta-analysis results summarized by the guideline were not atomized as if the guideline generated those results. Primary-study atoms require direct reading of the cited primary publications.
Biographic/disclosure profiles were not atomized beyond guideline-level methodological context because they are not formal clinical guidance assertions.
